crossRefs.note: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.
“If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
“ ‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and…
A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

people.name: Hebrews
people.line: An ethnic group descended from Abraham.

translations.web: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
translations.bsb: If a fellow Hebrew, a man or a woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you must set him free.
translations.kjv: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free
translations.asv: If thy brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
